name: Warded Lock Picking
description: Warded locks are an older design found in padlocks, old door hardware, and some storage facilities. They have static internal obstacles (wards) that a key's profile must clear. Warded picks are designed with minimal profiles to bypass these wards without the correct key shape. Most warded locks have minimal security against picking and open with negligible effort once the correct pick profile is identified.

blue.det: Warded locks are legacy hardware — their presence is itself a vulnerability indicator.
blue.cm: Replace all warded locks with modern pin tumbler or electronic access; warded locks provide minimal security and should not be used in any security application.
